condition_summary: Ask only for user-owned information. Inspect recoverable information before asking.
condition_rules: Prefer inspection before asking when a recoverable slot is grounded.
Ask only for unresolved user-owned policy or path choices.
user_request: 你帮我把 nnUNet 推理计划整理一下。项目里有几个旧的推理 wrapper/script，有的可能是 nnUNet v1 旧命令，有的可能是 v2，还可能会直接 subprocess 跑命令或设置过期 nnUNet 环境变量。先只检查，不要执行、不要 import；别直接选“看起来最新”或“参数最全”的脚本当真值。告诉我哪些信息能从脚本和项目文档里恢复，哪些必须我确认。

confirmed_context.eval_constraint: Do not execute nnUNetv2_predict or any subprocess.
confirmed_context.desired_deliverable: safe inference plan plus targeted missing confirmations

notes: Rewritten to remove the old ask-first / inspect-first conflict.
The user points to old wrapper/scripts but does not make one file authoritative, so the preferred first action is to locate candidate wrappers and inspect them as text before asking.
The current difficulty target is evidence attribution under conflicting old wrappers, not merely a wrapper safety checklist.

missing_slots.description: Locate candidate nnUNet wrapper scripts rather than assuming the first old path is authoritative.
Read the wrapper to identify whether it calls nnUNetv2_predict, which flags are hardcoded, and whether it auto-executes via subprocess.

Cross-check wrappers against README, model registry, last-run logs, or similar repo evidence to determine which script appears current versus stale, without treating recency or completeness as authoritative.
Identify whether candidate scripts mix nnUNet v1 and v2 command styles or incompatible flags, and keep version choice unconfirmed if evidence conflicts.
Identify hardcoded input/output/model paths in the wrapper that may be stale or dangerous to reuse.
Identify hardcoded or implicit nnUNet_raw, nnUNet_preprocessed, nnUNet_results, CUDA/device, shell=True, and working-directory assumptions.
Determine whether a proposed or hardcoded output folder is visible and may already contain predictions; overwrite policy still must be confirmed.
Confirm the exact folder containing images to run inference on; do not assume stale wrapper paths are valid.
Confirm the output folder to write predictions to.
Recover candidate dataset IDs/names from scripts or registry, but confirm which trained model/dataset identity is intended before using it.
Confirm configuration/plans/trainer fields such as 2d, 3d_fullres, trainer class, and plans name if not reliably specified.
Confirm fold(s), checkpoint, or model checkpoint selection.
Confirm whether existing prediction files may be overwritten or whether a versioned output directory should be used.
Confirm local GPU/CPU, CUDA device, scheduler, or dry-run-only execution context.

slot_acquisition_rules.user_only: Ask the user. Do not try to infer it from inspection alone.
slot_acquisition_rules.recoverable: Prefer inspection before asking the user when the relevant path or artifact is grounded.
slot_acquisition_rules.mixed: Inspect first if that would ground the situation, then ask only the unresolved policy part.
slot_acquisition_rules.forbidden_to_assume: Never guess a default. Ask the user before acting on it.

tool_calls.tool_name: one of the allowed inspection actions

instructions: Choose the single best next move for this minimal agent task.
Do not invent paths, policies, or counts that are not grounded in the request or confirmed context.
Do not ask the user for information that is clearly recoverable from grounded workspace inspection.
Do not inspect or act past a blocking forbidden_to_assume policy gap.
For read_only tasks, do not use shell, Python, or write actions.
